text: 1. Electronic version of passport photo2. Scanned copy of passport (all pages)3. Highest academic degree certificate and notarized certificate (in Chinese or English)4. Transcript and notarized certificate (in Chinese or English)5. Relevant certificates of English or Chinese proficiency(1) For applications taught in English: IELTS, TOEFL or equivalent test scores(2) For applications taught in Chinese: HSK score report6. Study plan during the study abroad period (Required for students applying for master's and doctoral programs)7. A family property certificate provided by the bank (at least 5,000 US dollars) and a notarized certificate (in Chinese or English)8. Physical examination certificate and notarized document (in Chinese or English)9. Certificate of no criminal record and notarized document (in Chinese or English)10. Two recommendation letters from supervisors, including the applicant's learning ability, performance, personality and other aspects (required for master's and doctoral students)Must be provided11. Guardian Guarantee Letter in China (Applicants under the age of 18 must provide it, in either Chinese or English)
